Remove the deprecated Spring Boot resource-provider wrappers and register their javaagent implementations directly. This changes the class names used in `otel.java.enabled.resource.providers` and `otel.java.disabled.resource.providers`.

```properties
# Before
otel.java.disabled.resource.providers=io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.spring.resources.SpringBootServiceNameDetector

# After
otel.java.disabled.resource.providers=io.opentelemetry.javaagent.instrumentation.spring.boot.resources.SpringBootServiceNameDetector
```

The same package change applies to `SpringBootServiceVersionDetector` entries in either property.
metadata.title: Remove deprecated Spring Boot resource provider wrappers
